pointers.sentence: `GenericForeignKey.contribute_to_class` sets the descriptor on the class under the field's name (`django/contrib/contenttypes/fields.py:GenericForeignKey.contribute_to_class`).

`GenericForeignKeyDescriptor.__get__` hands an object not yet loaded to the instance's fetch mode, as other relations do since 6.1 (`django/contrib/contenttypes/fields.py:GenericForeignKeyDescriptor.__get__`; [What changed in querysets](querysets.md)).

Since 5.0 `GenericPrefetch` gives `prefetch_related` a queryset for each model a generic key reaches, where a `Prefetch` holds one (`django/contrib/contenttypes/prefetch.py:GenericPrefetch`; [Generic foreign keys: `GenericForeignKey`](../contrib/generic-foreign-key.md)).

Under all four releases `find` hands each finder `find_all=` by keyword, so a finder whose own `find` still declares `all=` raises `TypeError`, unwarned (`django/contrib/staticfiles/finders.py:find`; [Finding static files: the finders](../contrib/static-finders.md)).

5.2.17 named each skipped file at verbosity 1, "Found another file with the destination path …", and counted none (`django/contrib/staticfiles/management/commands/collectstatic.py`; [Collecting static files: the collectstatic command](../contrib/collectstatic.md)).
5.2.17 wrote them in the order it held them (`django/contrib/staticfiles/storage.py:ManifestFilesMixin.save_manifest`, `docs/releases/6.0.txt`).
5.2.17 wrote them in the order it held them (`django/contrib/staticfiles/storage.py:ManifestFilesMixin.save_manifest`, `docs/releases/6.0.txt`).
The notes say every `SyndicationFeed` class writes them (`docs/releases/5.2.txt`), but only `RssFeed` and its subclasses do, through `RssFeed.add_stylesheets`.

`Atom1Feed.write` never calls that hook, so under all four releases an `Atom1Feed` given a stylesheet writes none (`django/utils/feedgenerator.py:Atom1Feed.write`; [Feeds: `django.contrib.syndication` and the feed generator](../contrib/feeds.md#stylesheets)).

5.2 had deprecated it for `order_by=`, and 6.0 gave `order_by=` to `Aggregate` itself (`django/db/models/aggregates.py:Aggregate.__init__`; [What changed in expressions, lookups and the compiler](sql.md)).
`Aggregate.__init__` passes a keyword it does not know on to `Func.__init__`, which keeps it as context for a template that never reads it (`django/db/models/expressions.py:Func.__init__`).
All go in Django 2028 (`django/contrib/postgres/aggregates/general.py`; [The PostgreSQL application: `PostgresConfig`, operations and aggregates](../contrib/postgres.md#functions-and-aggregates)).
The PostgreSQL class sent the string as a parameter, and warned (`django/db/models/aggregates.py:StringAgg.__init__`).
When it is not, `CheckPostgresInstalledMixin.check` adds the error `"postgres.E005"` (`django/contrib/postgres/utils.py:CheckPostgresInstalledMixin`).
